name: NFL Stat Leaders
author: ChuckBuilds
description: A scrolling ticker of the NFL's statistical leaders -- passing, rushing and receiving yards and touchdowns, plus receptions, sacks, interceptions, tackles and passer rating. Each category is a separate leaderboard you can turn on or off, drawn with club crests and club colours. Data comes from ESPN's public feed, so no API key is needed.

versions.notes: Initial release. Scrolling NFL statistical leaderboards from ESPN's public leaders feed (no API key). Eleven categories, six of them on by default: passing, rushing and receiving yards and touchdowns. Each board shows a rank badge, the club crest, the player and the number, coloured from the crest's own dominant colour, with gold/silver/bronze badges for the top three. Requires LEDMatrix core 3.4.0 for the frame hold the scroll pacing passes to set_scrolling_state().

api_requirements.name: ESPN API
api_requirements.description: ESPN's public NFL leaders feed. No API key and no account are required.
